title: tc-transcript-review
description:
A recording with a transcript that follows playback: timestamps, speakers, recognition and translation confidence,
low-confidence segments marked, search, and "Send to verification".

speakers.description: Names, chip text and colours for the speaker ids in `segments`; an id with no entry shows as itself

src.description: The recording's URL; the element makes its own <audio> or <video> (see `kind`). Ignored when `media` is set

kind.description: What `src` is: "audio" (default) or "video", which shows the picture above the waveform

peaks.description: The waveform: loudness peaks from 0 to 1, as many as you have – they're resampled to fit the width

duration.description: The recording's length in seconds, until the media reports it (default: the last segment's end)

threshold.description: Segments and words with confidence below this (0–1) are marked for checking

heading.description: The heading, and the region's name

description.description: The quiet line under the heading (default: the length and how many speakers)

translationMode.description: What the transcript shows when segments have translations: the original, the translation, or both side by side

originalLabel.description: The name of the original language's column and button, e.g. "Spanish"

translationLabel.description: The name of the translation's column and button, e.g. "English (machine)"

hiddenSpeakers.description: Speaker ids whose segments the list leaves out

sent.description: Ids of segments already sent to verification

verifiable.description: Shows "Send to verification" on each segment (default true)

skip.description: How far J and L (and the back and forward buttons) jump, in seconds

maxHeight.description: The tallest the list grows, in px, before it scrolls

start.description: Seconds from the start of the recording

speaker.description: A speaker's id – named and coloured by `speakers`

translation.description: The text in the other language

words.description: The words of `text` in order, each with its own confidence

confidence.description: 0–1; below the element's `threshold` the word is underlined as uncertain

TranscriptWord.description: A word with its own recognition confidence – optional detail inside a segment

short.description: The chip's text – default the name's initials ("Speaker 1" → "S1")

tone.description: The chip's colour – default the next in turn
